integrity: The proof derives unit-pattern class sizes directly from the finite local decomposition, proves all at-most-one-white profiles force by an inclusion-maximal pattern argument, uses an invertible Kronecker quotient matrix for the rank witness, and gives an exact multiset algorithm for recovering residue-field orders from polynomial roots.
scientific_limitations: Every local factor must be a nonfield; field factors create singleton unit-pattern classes requiring a different forcing analysis.
The polynomial recovers only the product of the local maximal-ideal sizes, not those sizes individually.
Residue-field orders are recovered only as an unordered multiset, which is sufficient for graph isomorphism.
Minimum rank is over real symmetric graph-pattern matrices.
title: Zero forcing polynomials recognize comaximal graphs with no field local factors
